title: TabulariaRunFacet
description: A run facet Tabularia attaches to every run it reports: the run in Tabularia and the orchestration or flow group that contains it, also when the job is not a child in the catalog's job hierarchy (a datasource refresh or a nested flow's output triggered by an orchestration; a flow, refresh, SQL script or saved script run by a flow group).

runId.description: The id of the run in Tabularia: GET /runs/{id}. Absent for a notebook's session, which is not a run of Tabularia's history

kind.description: orchestration = a flow run, a saved script's run or a flow group's run; flow = one output node of a flow run; ingest = a datasource refresh; sql = a SQL script writing its datasource; script / container = a Script or Container node, or a Container cell; pushmail = a Pushmail cell; notebook = a notebook's session

engine.description: The engine the run executed on, the scripting environment and its version, or the container registry, when known

parentRunId.description: The OpenLineage runId of the orchestration or flow group run this run belongs to, if any

version.description: The version of the SQL script, saved script or notebook that ran

mode.description: A notebook's session: its app, or its editor
